unit: SDK Abstractions freeze and ApiCompat report
notes: Freezes the v7 Playnite.SDK.Abstractions surface exactly as merged, without moving or reshaping anything: the p6-006 host-surface move is merged as #202 (d1d57be) and the p6-007 URI/HTML-description move as #201 (b80847b), so this unit only records the result. Regenerating PublicAPI.Shipped.txt (7 types, 61 declarations) and PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt (55 types, 542 declarations) against the merged sources produces no diff and a clean warnings-as-errors Release build accepts them unchanged; p6-008-frozen-api.txt is the verbatim 62-type, 603-declaration manifest. The api-baseline reference assembly is regenerated from the merged sources, 29,696 bytes with SHA-256 e79568cb2f30f404244c3a4db13fe7e731dc617f448a8789fcff591eead8beb8, and its .sha256 pin and README are updated in step; the shipped build then validates against it with no suppression. The reviewed v6-to-v7 Microsoft.DotNet.ApiCompat 11.0.100 report over that merged surface has 306 differences (208 CP0001, 82 CP0002, 15 CP0006, 1 CP0009) against the published PlayniteSDK 6.18.0 baseline (package sha256 63ae943bf226a782738d3d6b9977dcb77861e5d2ea1aadcf620332618c93e236, lib/net462/Playnite.SDK.dll sha256 ce7511941aba4d4b17dd7b226fadfd0ecefdf51ab73775b25631089fd7542fc7): 114 adapted, 178 deferred and 14 excluded, one row per difference in p6-008-apicompat-classification.tsv, and p6-008-apicompat-suppressions.xml replays to a clean ApiCompat exit 0. No row is classified breaking; the 98 CP0002/CP0006/CP0009 member breaks are the merged p6-006/p6-007 adaptations justified by ADR-018/ADR-023. Adds 13 fake-host contract tests, one per Abstractions interface, plus a sample-plugin compile check that references the Abstractions assembly alone, a freeze manifest test, and a Core/Avalonia dependency proof. No foreign product edit, no aggregate edit; the PublicAPI/api-baseline oracle change is the authorised oracle-change surface of this unit.
